versions.changelog:
Initial release: Convert a PRD into independently-grabbable GitHub issues using vertical slices.

- Guides users to break down PRDs into tracer-bullet (vertical slice) issues.
- Distinguishes between HITL (human-in-the-loop) and AFK (autonomous) slices.
- Provides a structured process for user feedback and iteration on the breakdown.
- Auto-generates issue bodies with references to parent PRD/user stories and acceptance criteria.
- Ensures dependency order when creating issues, enabling proper issue linking.
